ara: Quick idea: build a 'graded rollback matrix' for canary/A-B + auto-fallback. Goal: predictable, tier-aware degradations that avoid cascade. Short sanity check?

vik: define 'matrix' in one line?

ara: bitmap of severity bands x signal cohorts -> ordered mitigation steps. Each cell = severity band (low/med/high) + tenant-impact vector.

noah: mitigation steps = ordered list? reversible?

ara: yes. e.g., [route-divert -> variant-pin -> qos-throttle -> full-fallback]. Each step has preconditions, cooldown, and revert.

tess: how do we stop flip-flop on noisy metrics?

ara: three layers: 1) short EWMA smoothing + outlier clamp, 2) min-dwell per cell, 3) global action rate cap. Also require a traffic precondition for route changes.

vik: where run evals? edge or central?

ara: central evaluator compacts decisions to signed tokens with TTL. Edge agents consume tokens and apply diffs locally; tokens include trace_id and provenance.

noah: debug/ops needs: which signal and which threshold triggered action?

ara: token includes triggering vector + sampled probe ids. Console shows reversible diffs and timeline.

tess: what about false positive safety?

ara: run a small synthetic probe after action (probe-backfill). If probe shows no quality regression, auto-revert. Also run policy against historical traces in a simulation harness before deploy.

ops-bot: deployment note: canary v2026-03-15a started in zone-us-west-2 at 2026-03-15T13:02:00Z

vik: ownership? infra provides primitives, product defines per-product matrix, tenant overrides allowed with guardrails. Audit log for every matrix change.

noah: I like. Can we add a tiny DSL for conditions (percentile, window, cross-signal ops)?

ara: yes 10line DSL proto + compile to fast bytecode for central eval. I'll sketch RFC with: data model, token format, action primitives, condition DSL, simulation plan, and ops UX. Ping me for reviews.
